L3Harris Technologies is an agile global aerospace and defense technology innovator, delivering end-to-end solutions that meet customers’ mission-critical needs. The company provides advanced defense and commercial technologies across space, air, land, sea and cyber domains. L3Harris has approximately $18 billion in annual revenue and 47,000 employees, with customers in more than 100 countries.

Job Description:

The Information Security Systems Engineer will be involved in Information Assurance (IA) related architecture development, CONOPS development, trade studies, requirements analysis and flow down to hardware/software configuration items as well as requirements validation and verification. This position requires DoD IA expertise to support embedment of cryptographic components within tactical radio platforms. The candidate should have a good understanding of DoD Configuration Management (CM) processes and management of formal Engineering Change Proposals (ECP). The Candidate will interact with mechanical, electrical and SW engineers to make sure designs meet security requirements.

Essential Functions:

- Must have experience with security requirements analysis and specification generation.
- Highly motivated, a self starter, and able to operate with little supervision in diverse environments.
- Must have a successful track record in planning, executing, and tracking personal task assignments.
- Experience with emerging security standards and evolution of NSA certification processes.
- Must have experience with certification of secure architectures.
- Active Secret U.S. Security Clearance or ability to obtain one.

Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering discipline and minimum 4 years of developing embedded software-based engineering solutions. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 2 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 8 years of prior related experience.

Preferred Additional Skills:

- Strong verbal and written communication skills.
- Radio communications or networking experience preferred
- Knowledge of configuration management tools

Job Description:

L3Harris is seeking a Specialist, Cyber Intelligence to serve as the primary Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM) and Assistant Facility Security Officer (AFSO) supporting Space and Mission Systems programs in Northampton, MA. The position leads cybersecurity compliance for classified information systems and supports administration of the industrial security program in accordance with corporate policies, NISPOM/32 CFR Part 117, and applicable U.S. Government requirements. - Provide on‑site AFSO support for classified programs, including security compliance, account management, auditing, and support to the FSO for secure operations.

- Lead RMF and authorization activities, including development and maintenance of security documentation, control implementation and assessment, POA&Ms, continuous monitoring, and ATO sustainment.
- Manage information‑system security configuration and change‑control processes, reviewing hardware, software, firmware, account, and network changes that may impact the authorized security posture.
- Perform or coordinate system‑security administration and technical compliance activities, including vulnerability scanning, STIG implementation, patching, antivirus updates, GPOs, encryption management, audit‑log review, and security‑event analysis.
- Conduct or support system assessments, self‑inspections, customer and Government inspections, incident response, corrective‑action development, remediation tracking, and closure of cybersecurity findings.
- Support physical security and access control for classified areas, including badging, visitor management, alarm‑response coordination, and facility‑security compliance in support of the FSO.
- Support classified document, media, and material control, including accountability, storage, inventory, transmission, reproduction, sanitization, and destruction.
- Deliver security training and awareness and coordinate activities with internal stakeholders, external customers, and Government agencies.
- Perform additional assigned security duties and support limited travel as required.

Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 4 years of related cybersecurity or industrial‑security experience; OR 8 years of relevant experience in lieu of a degree.
- Active US Secret clearance required
- Experience serving as an ISSM or ISSO for classified information systems.
- Experience with RMF processes, system authorization/assessment, continuous monitoring, and cybersecurity compliance documentation.
- Experience supporting classified programs in accordance with NISPOM, DAAPM, and applicable Government security requirements.
- Experience with vulnerability assessments, system hardening, remediation tracking, and security compliance in a secure Windows environment.
- Experience performing industrial‑security functions including personnel security, physical security, classified media/document control, and inspection support.

Preferred Additional Skills:

- Security+, CISSP, or other relevant cybersecurity or industrial‑security certification
- Experience with DCSA authorization guidance and tools (e.g., DAAPM).
- Hands‑on experience with vulnerability/compliance tools such as Nessus, ACAS, or SCAP.
- Strong Windows secure‑administration skills including patching, antivirus, GPOs, BitLocker, account management, and log analysis.
- Experience with classified document accountability, media sanitization, destruction procedures, and security‑training/awareness programs.
